name: Eitrigg's Wisdom

narrative.details:
Rend lives?

Impossible!

It had been thought that Rend  was slain decades ago.

Seek out the wisdom of Eitrigg, adventurer. None know the workings of the Blackrock better than he and if what is written here bares truth, Eitrigg should be informed. No person should be denied the right of vengeance.

You will find him in Orgrimmar.

Once you have spoken with Eitrigg, confer with the Warchief to find out what he wishes to do about this problem.
narrative.objectives:
Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall.

You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Thrall appears dismayed by the news you bring.>
narrative.requestItemsText: Can you not see that I must not be interrupted?

chain.subtitle: 14 quests at level 60, 86,600 XP in all.

quests.name: Warlord's Command
quests.objectiveText: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak.

quests.name: For The Horde!
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand.

quests.name: The Champion of the Horde
quests.objectiveText: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts.

quests.name: The Testament of Rexxar
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Oculus Illusions
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes.

quests.name: Emberstrife
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
quests.objectiveText: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
quests.objectiveText: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
quests.objectiveText: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu.

quests.name: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight.

quests.name: Ascension...
quests.objectiveText: It would appear as if the charade is over.

quests.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath.
